summary:
Implement the one confirmed AlembicPlugin consumer package after accepted AlembicCore commit 7ccddf2372ddaeac2dbcfc1f651157d753709cd7. Baseline AlembicPlugin commit is be7bc058fcd188f38b48ee551f912377c2d19f1d; keep all work in AlembicPlugin and return one clean commit.

P1 — request-scoped reader-only retrieval:
- Consume the accepted Core public EmbeddingPort, VectorIndexReader, KnowledgeRetrievalPolicy/Port and raw candidate evidence.
- Refactor public Search and Prime request graphs so they construct only snapshot DB truth, query embedding, a reader-only HNSW adapter and canonical retrieval. They must not construct IndexingPipeline, VectorService, VectorIndexWriter, lifecycle/reconcile/init/rescan/rebuild, or any write-shaped request adapter.
- Search and Prime must use the same query/filter/topK candidate sequence. Remove Prime's independent 0.45/relative admission threshold and score calibration; Prime may only group/project the already-authoritative candidates and must expose bounded ordered candidateRecipeIds.
- Preserve dense similarity/rank, sparse score/rank and per-lane/raw RRF contribution through public projection. With embeddings unavailable, sparse truth still works; empty authoritative knowledge returns empty.
- Frozen eight English BiliDili query fixtures must be non-empty and place Recipe <redacted> in Top 3 without synonym hardcoding or Recipe edits.

P2/P3 — shared real-time ProjectContext:
- Add a Plugin-owned ProjectContextBuildSessionManager injected into Graph and Recipe Map, keyed by canonical real project root + normalized scope + source/manifest fact fingerprint (exists, size, high-resolution mtime, sha256), never Git state.
- Merge same-key in-flight work and use ref-counted cancellation. Graph and Recipe Map consume one fact session; Map only adds deterministic Recipe mounts and must not rebuild source facts.
- Route explicit file/symbol/sourceSlice/anchor requests through a narrow fast path before space/all-repo/map/module traversal. The containing repo identity may be read; unrelated repositories must not be scanned.
- Full-space work publishes deterministic per-repository chunks. Repo failures/timeouts remain explicit coverage outcomes.
- Add opaque, project-confined continuation with {resultRef,factSessionRef,nextCursor,hasMore,page,accumulatedCounts}. Pages are deterministic deltas and reconstruct without duplicates or missing stable IDs; partial results must stay honestly partial.
- Store chunks only in owner-only OS/runtime temp, never projectRoot/dataRoot. Terminal consumption, explicit cancel, exception and TTL expiry must remove all temp files. Expired cursors return bounded retry guidance and need not survive process restart.
- Propagate one AbortSignal from the unchanged 120-second host deadline through handler/session/Core ProjectContext; abort before response and wait for bounded cleanup acknowledgement so a slow worker actually stops.
- Keep deprecated raw-path fullMapRef null; do not expose paths in result refs/cursors.

Boundaries:
- Preserve Guard as a read-only regression consumer; do not redesign Guard.
- No persistent answer cache, knowledge writes, Git revision/checkpoint/dirty/branch checks, host-selected-project coupling, role/Admin/intent/knowledge-state/tool-visibility gates, hardcoded synonyms, Recipe edits, Test window, Alembic/AlembicAgent/AlembicDashboard source edits, vendor or release changes.
- No higher heavy-tool deadline and no query-time vector maintenance.

Required verification/evidence:
- Focused RED/GREEN tests for Search/Prime parity, orphan/deprecated truth, public raw evidence, reader-only fingerprint/zero mutation, BuildSession reuse/invalidation/ref-count cancellation, narrow fast path, 2+ cursor-page reconstruction, explicit repo failure, cursor confinement, terminal/cancel/error/TTL cleanup, and real worker-stop timeout.
- Required Design commands: focused unit suites; Zod schema integration; full npm run test:unit; npm run build:check; npm run check; npm run build; npm run verify:codex-runtime-package; plugin package/manifest verification if defined by repository rules.
- Record exact Core and Plugin commits, changed files/symbols, runtime/package entry hashes, zero-write fingerprints, and two-stage self-review (requirement compliance, then failure paths/performance/cleanup).
- Do not claim final real BiliDili/AlembicWorkspace acceptance: controller will independently reload the canonical runtime and run the fixed BiliDili Search/Prime matrix plus dual-project Graph/Map/Guard, cursor, fast-path and zero-write checks after accepting this commit.
designIntent: Make every public knowledge query request-scoped and reader-only, and make Graph/Map share a cancellable ephemeral fact build with honest pagination.

required.verify: One clean AlembicPlugin commit consuming exact Core commit 7ccddf2372ddaeac2dbcfc1f651157d753709cd7; clean tree and exact changed files.
Focused retrieval/session/schema/timeout suites plus full unit/check/build/package verification pass, with raw command summaries.
Public Search/Prime runtime graph has no writer/lifecycle/indexing/reconcile/init/rescan/rebuild edge and protected data fingerprints remain unchanged.
Search and Prime ordered candidate IDs match; target Recipe is Top 3 for all eight frozen queries; raw dense/sparse/RRF evidence survives projection.
Same root/scope Graph and Recipe Map build facts once, source/manifest changes invalidate without Git, and explicit file/symbol uses the narrow path.
At least three pages reconstruct stable facts exactly once; cursor/ref is opaque/project-confined; repo failures remain explicit.
Unchanged 120-second deadline propagates AbortSignal to a real worker that stops; terminal/cancel/error/TTL leave zero temp files.
Two-stage requirement and code-quality/failure-path/performance review completed with blockers resolved.

targetTasks.summary: Integrate accepted Core commit 7ccddf2372ddaeac2dbcfc1f651157d753709cd7 into one AlembicPlugin package for canonical five-tool retrieval and cancellable shared ProjectContext sessions.
